meta.title: What if you were born as Kim Kardashian? (30-second style test)

voice.style: documentary narrator, steady and clear, slightly brisk

sentences.text: You are born in Los Angeles on October 21st, 1980.
Your father, a lawyer, will join the O. J. Simpson defense team.
When you are nine, your parents divorce.
Two years later, your mother marries Olympic champion Bruce Jenner.
In 2007, cameras move in, and your family becomes a TV show.
By 2025, your brand, SKIMS, is valued at five billion dollars.

sources.claim: Robert Kardashian was on the O. J. Simpson defense team (1994-95 trial)
Parents divorced in 1989; Kris married Bruce Jenner in 1991
Bruce Jenner won the 1976 Olympic decathlon
Keeping Up with the Kardashians premiered October 2007
SKIMS valued at $5 billion in Nov 2025 ($225M round led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives)
sources.note: URL must be re-verified before the full documentary is published
